text:
Alex S: Quick postmortem follow-up on the DNS backoff regression we saw yesterday — seems to be causing cross-region LB retry storms and intermittent TLS handshakes. I filed RW-2547. Need owners for remediation + perf mitigation. tagging @Maya K @Chris T
Maya K: I can take ownership of the backoff algorithm fix. Initial glance shows a change in the jitter math in commit 7f3a1c that effectively removed the exponential cap. Will validate and submit revert PR if confirmed. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Chris T: I'll own the canary and deploy plan. Need to validate across eu-west and us-east routes and a staged rollback path. I'll add test vectors for 0-8s, 8-64s windows.
Kevin P: Re: TLS failures — saw correlation between retries and TLS session cache misses on edge. Could be connection churn from aggressive retrying. I'll instrument edge for session reuse metrics.
Anita R: I'll coordinate customer comms for teams with Dedicated capacity in affected regions. Draft notice ready, holding until we have an ETA and mitigation.
sre-bot: Incident RW-2547 status updated: assigned -> monitoring. Link: https://redwood.example/incidents/RW-2547 :eyes:
Maya K: quick log snippet from the edge during a surge:```
[2026-03-20T11:22:03Z] route=eu-west-1 host=lb-edge-3 retry_backoff=0.5s attempts=5 tls_handshake=fail
[2026-03-20T11:22:03Z] route=us-east-1 host=lb-edge-1 retry_backoff=0.5s attempts=6 tls_handshake=fail
```
Maya K: note the backoff staying tiny despite high attempts — that's the regression signal.
Chris T: Good catch. Can you add a small harness to reproduce locally? Something that simulates upstream NACKs + gradual connection failures.
Maya K: Yep. PoC script in the ticket comments. Example run:```bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -v -H 'Host: test.redwood' https://lb-test || sleep 0.1; done
```
Kevin P: From the TLS side, enabling session ticket logging shows session reuse dropped from ~95% to ~40% during the incident window. That explains longer handshake timeouts and occasional cert verify errors.
Anita R: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) revert backoff change if validated (owner: Maya), 2) temporarily increase LB connection keepalive to preserve TLS sessions (owner: Kevin), 3) add a route-level throttle to prevent fanout to distant regions while we fix (owner: Chris).
Alex S: Please add timelines to each action and update RW-2547. Also add postmortem follow-up item to weekly SRE review for recurring pattern analysis.
Maya K: Update: found offending line in 7f3a1c — missing max multiplier. Preparing revert PR now: PR#4123. ETA: 3 hours for tests and CI.
Chris T: Canary plan: deploy revert to canary pool (10% traffic) -> monitor retries, TLS metrics for 30m -> if green, roll to 50% -> 100% with 5m ramp steps. I'll own the rollout and gates.
Kevin P: I applied a conservative keepalive bump on canary LB nodes: from 90s -> 300s. Monitoring session_reuse, handshake_fail_rate. Will roll back if we see file descriptor pressure.
Anita R: Draft customer note ready, will send after canary confirms. Tagging affected customers list RW-AFFECTED-2026-03-20.
Alex S: Also need longer-term: add an automated regression test that asserts backoff doesn't shrink below computed minimum for high attempt counts. Add to eng-qa and perf suites. Owner: Maya + Chris.
Maya K: Agreed. I'll add unit tests for the backoff util and a load test scenario for infra perf. RW-2547 subtask RW-2547-2 for tests.
Chris T: I'll add e2e check in the canary job that fails the job if tls_handshake_fail_rate > 0.5% or session_reuse < 80% during the window.
Kevin P: Monitoring alert adjustments: create temporary threshold overrides to avoid alert storm during the rollback window. Then tune back after metrics stabilize. I'll file RW-2548 for the alerts.
Alex S: Thanks. Action items recap (please confirm):
- Maya: revert PR#4123, unit tests, RW-2547-2 (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Chris: canary rollout plan + e2e gate, run canary today once revert merged (ETA today afternoon)
- Kevin: keepalive bump on canary LB, instrument session_reuse metrics, RW-2548 (ETA 2 hrs)
- Anita: customer comms + send notice after canary success (hold)
- Alex: add weekly SRE review slot for recurring incident pattern analysis
Maya K: Confirmed. I'll link PR and test logs to RW-2547.
Chris T: Confirmed. Will post canary playbook in the ticket and ping #oncall when starting.
Kevin P: Confirmed. Instrumentation live, alert ticket created.
Anita R: Confirmed.
Alex S: We'll reconvene in this thread after canary results. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
